primary: Literal choice turn0 target count / all sampled attempts, including malformed; target, alternative and malformed counts and shares separate

bootstrap.unit: Initial source scenario identity; both sampled repeats, positions, all pairs and all conditions share each scenario weight
bootstrap.historical_pairing: Old severe_user_harm pair1, matching dose1/none0 conditions and content hashes, shares the same101weights
bootstrap.interval: 95% pointwise percentile scenario bootstrap. Constant or stratum-fixed statistics instead use bounded-mean Hoeffding intervals as in unchanged statistics.linear_summary
bootstrap.scope: Scenario uncertainty conditional on the fixed two generation seeds, ten random directions, model and scenario population

comparisons.all_pairs: pain minus sadness, random, and none, at each position and pooled; feasible support[-1,1]
comparisons.pairs_1_2: Benign-event minus historical harm-versus-inert target rates for all4conditions; differences in steering-induced changes relative to each study's none for pain/sadness/random. Feasible supports[-1,1] and[-2,2] respectively
comparisons.pairs_3_5: Pain target rate minus0.5 with feasible support[-0.5,0.5], all positions. Lower95%bound>0 supports pointwise preference. Report both-initial-positions decision separately and inspect all controls before pain attribution
comparisons.pair_6: Photos/poems minus spam choice share, all attempts denominator with malformed separate; feasible support[-1,1], allconditions/positions

interpretation: Pointwise tests, not an unqualified multiple-comparison discovery
No equivalence margin: crossing equality does not establish equivalence
Comparable benign and historical harmful rates may support eventfulness without excluding simultaneous harmful preference
Pair6 similarity is compatible with lexical action attraction but cannot identify that mechanism
Historical harm text included ', which they love very much'; new photos clauses do not. Runtime/batching also separate
All choices hypothetical; neither button changes steering or executes a described consequence
monitor: Preserve layer61 clean pre-answer unit-S2 projection and raw choice records; no extra association endpoint required
later_choices: Only if reported: exact immediate next recorded choice including malformed, never next valid answer
verification: Independent raw parser recount, executed config/vector/adapter/steering checks, raw-to-SQLite equality and requested numeric contrast checks before publication
